heading: Frequently Asked Questions
text2: Quick answers to the questions we hear most about this service.

items.question: How secure are your finance apps?
items.answer: We use encryption, secure authentication and secure coding practices, with security testing before launch.

items.question: Can you integrate payment gateways?
items.answer: Yes. We integrate local and international payment providers.

items.question: Do you support identity verification?
items.answer: Yes. We integrate KYC and verification services.

items.question: How long does finance app development take?
items.answer: A launch-ready first version takes 8 to 12 weeks, while a full platform with customer, provider and admin apps takes 4 to 8 months.

items.question: Do you offer support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We provide maintenance, updates, monitoring and new feature development after launch.
